state.name: Application
state.summary: Runs Node.js apps, containers and Docker Compose projects, served on a domain through Nginx.
details: Installs Docker and Node.js versions when they are needed; they are not part of the default install.
Each application gets its own internal port and RAM/CPU limits, and runs as the customer's user.
A website set to Application mode has Nginx point at the installed application.
notes: Backups do not include application data yet (the apps folder and named volumes).
Docker images and volumes do not count toward the customer's disk quota yet.
